name: echoic-guard-class-bonus-costs-two-prevents-two-decline-copy
notes: Echoic Guard (gn1b2sbrq9, NEOS/GUARDIAN ACTION, printed reserve 3): "[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate. Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to target ally this turn. Then you may pay (X) where X is that ally's reserve cost. If you do, summon a token copy of that ally." Same double-Class-Bonus-discount engine bug as Shifting Mirage (generated activationCostModifierAbilities['gn1b2sbrq9:0'] AND the ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table). The champion is Tonoris, Creation's Will (NEOS + GUARDIAN); a Dungeon Guide (reserve 3) is the target. Exactly TWO reserve payments pay for the card (unresolved after one, resolved after two), the target gets the PREVENT_ALL_2 effect, and the optional (X) copy payment is declined (no token copy, memory stays 2).

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate.
Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to target ally this turn.
Then you may pay (X) ... summon a token copy of that ally. (declined)

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Echoic Guard' printed '[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate' was applied TWICE: once by the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['gn1b2sbrq9:0'] (via ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers) and once more by the hand-maintained ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table in Custom/GameLogic.php (which still listed gn1b2sbrq9). With the Class Bonus active, printed reserve 3 became 1 instead of 2 (same defect first confirmed live on Shifting Mirage; swept from the table: this card measured with=1 expected 2). Fix: the three cards that already carry a generated '[Class Bonus] -1' activation modifier (hmjr33ijq6 Shifting Mirage, gn1b2sbrq9 Echoic Guard, gn1b2sbrq9 Echoic Guard) were removed from the ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table so the generated modifier is the single source of the discount; the exact cost (2 with the Class Bonus, 3 without) is now pinned. A sweep of all 65 table entries found no other card double-discounted (Galestream Insight usa6qyq3ka correctly keeps its table entry because its generated modifier is only the separate [Memory 4+] discount).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table (entries for hmjr33ijq6, n0esog2898, gn1b2sbrq9 removed) consumed by CalculateActivationReserveCost()
